# TradingView Lightweight Charts 5.0.9

Standalone production bundle from https://registry.npmjs.org/lightweight-charts/-/lightweight-charts-5.0.9.tgz, pinned and served locally.

SHA-256: `e6bd6516d9ab9cb897c0d6438e3fe1126f2fdce07e68c23836e84d527de81f52`.

License: Apache-2.0, see LICENSE. Upstream NOTICE from the matching v5.0.9 release is preserved. The portfolio adapter shows the notice and a TradingView link; the built-in attribution logo remains enabled.

The main portfolio chart alone uses this library. Existing stock-sheet, intraday and management chart components remain in place. Financial calculations stay in the PHP/Python services and the explicitly tested portfolio metric helpers. The adapter supplies data, interactions and purchase overlays, without a server dependency or a CDN request.
